sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English-based common law, French civil law influence, and indigenous customary law)

Vanuatu-People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Treaty (entered into force 2005)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act (Act No. 5 of 2020); Financial Transactions Reporting Act [Cap 231]; VFSC Beneficial Ownership (International Companies) Directive; FATF recommendations as transposed nationally.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport for each UBO and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of each natural person's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Vanuatu is a contracting party to the Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed banking institution in the address jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization for jurisdictions not party to the Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming business and professional standing of each shareholder/director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The relationship bank of the shareholder/director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from a licensed lawyer or accountant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The issuing law firm or accounting firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association (signed by subscriber)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Incorporator or registered agent preparing the draft
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by Vanuatu notary or registered agent; no apostille required if executed locally

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP screening, OFAC, UN Security Council sanctions lists, EU/UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, and Vanuatu domestic Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directives must be applied to all UBOs, directors, and officers before incorporation. An adverse match triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, and may be escalated to the VFSC for approval or rejection.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Online Corporate Registry Portal (https://www.vfsc.vu)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All company names must be expressed in Latin script. English and French are accepted; Bislama is permitted if accompanied by an English translation. Non-Latin names (e.g., Chinese, Cyrillic, Arabic) must be transliterated/romanized according to international standards (ISO 9 for Cyrillic; Pinyin for Chinese) and must be acceptable to the Registrar to avoid phonetic similarity to existing names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or licensed registered agent must file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar within 14 days of rejection notice. The appeal must include a proposed alternative name, explanatory memorandum, and any supporting trademark/prior-authority consents. The Registrar must issue a determination within 10 business days unless further information is requested. No statutory fee is charged for a first appeal; a second re-submission fee of USD 50 applies.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are generally not recognized as satisfying the statutory registered office requirement for a Vanuatu International Company. A physical registered office address in Vanuatu maintained by a licensed registered agent is mandatory. For an offshore International Company not conducting domestic operations, the registered agent's office is sufficient. However, for the proposed Data Center Colocation and Leasing business, if the company acquires physical local infrastructure or leases racks within Vanuatu, a local operating address is required to maintain commercial substance. A pure offshore holding model without local assets may rely on the registered agent's address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 5% for a non-licensed, non-resident International Company; 15% if the company elects to obtain domestic regulatory licences or establishes physical data center assets in Vanuatu. Unannounced inspections by VFSC are rare but possible under AML/CFT supervision.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Vanuatu), as amended; in particular ss. 4, 6, 8, 10, 13 and 118 concerning incorporation, registration, share capital, registered office and filing of the charter and memorandum.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Registry, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form VU-IC-01 – Application for Registration of an International Company, accompanied by the proposed Charter and Memorandum of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company. Shares may be issued in any currency, and no escrow deposit or capital funding is required at formation. The declared issued capital need only be recorded in the register of members; beneficial ownership declarations remain subject to VFSC record-keeping rules.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that this Company, incorporated as an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] of Vanuatu, is duly registered and its incorporation is approved. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the shares agreed in the register of members are issued to the initial subscribers and deemed fully paid to the extent of the consideration declared by the board. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be and is established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and such agent is authorised to receive service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the directors named in the register are appointed to office and are authorised to open bank accounts, execute colocation leases, obtain industrial licences and engage professional advisers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed corporate name and a summary of the intended colocation and hosting business to VFSC for availability and compliance review. The name must not imply government connection or restricted activity and must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd'.
required_dossiers: Copy of passport or national ID of each proposed director
Utility bill or bank reference evidencing residential address
Brief description of the data-center colocation business model
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is unavailable or flagged, submit up to two alternative names and amend the business description to remove prohibited expressions; VFSC will reinstate review within two days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting of Charter and Memorandum of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-recognised registered agent in Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Charter and Memorandum in English in the statutory form under the International Companies Act, including share classes, director powers, indemnity provisionsand the object to lease, host and operate digital infrastructure and server facilities.
required_dossiers: Statement of proposed directors and shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC returns the documents for non-compliance, the registered agent will prepare a written amendment schedule, refile the corrected charter, and liaise with the Companies Registry within one working day.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission and Payment of Incorporation Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form VU-IC-01 through the licensed registered agent, pay the state filing fee of USD 300, and submit all constitutional documents and a declaration of compliance with the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Statutory declaration of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a deficiency query, respond with a written explanation and corrected schedules within 14 days; the application will resume processing without a new fee if the query was raised by the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, collect the Certificate of Incorporation, the sealed Charter and Memorandum, the register of directors, the register of members, and the company seal. Verify the exact legal name and date of incorporation on the Certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any certificate contains a typographical discrepancy, submit a correction request with the certificate and supporting documents; VFSC will issue a corrected certificate within three working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirmation of Registered Office and Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC and licensed registered agent, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the registered office agreement and agency agreement with a VFSC-licensed agent, and file the notice of appointment of registered agent and location of the registered office if required by VFSC guidelines.
required_dossiers: Resolution confirming the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC requires an updated agent appointment form, file the prescribed notice and pay any minor administration fee; the agency records are corrected and a confirmation certificate is issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Share Issuance and Appointment of Officers by First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors of the International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, adopt the pro-forma resolution, issue share certificates to the initial shareholders, and appoint directors, a chair, a corporate secretary and such officers as necessary for bank, lease and licensing matters.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a shareholder or director refuses to sign the consent, the board may certify non-acceptance in writing and appoint a substitute officer; minutes are amended and adopted by a further board resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed commercial bank or licensed offshore bank in Vanuatu
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Provide the onboarding package to the selected bank, execute board-resolved account opening, and submit compliance declarations supporting low-risk data-center colocation fees received by monthly ACH or SWIFT wire. Maintain the bank due-diligence file with source-of-funds evidence.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution authorising account opening
Identity and address verification for all directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide certified passport copies, bank reference letters and a notarised source-of-funds declaration; resubmit within 10 banking days to avoid account rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licence Endorsement for Data-Center Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Trade, Industry and Investment / Port Vila Municipal Council
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for a municipal business licence under the Vanuatu Business Licence regime, naming the data-centre colocation and dedicated server hosting activities, and pay the annual municipal licence fee as assessed by the Council.
required_dossiers: Description of colocation, rack space and bare-metal hosting activities
Landlord consent or lease document for the data-centre facility
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Council classifies the activity under a different licence code, amend the application to the ICT infrastructure code and furnish the additional statement of activities; no new planning approval is required for a classification correction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Trade, Industry and Investment (Vanuatu Investment Promotion Agency) and Port Vila Municipal Council
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Business Licence – Category: Information and Communications Technology / Data-centre Infrastructure and Colocation Operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geohazards, Energy and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B – Environmental Registration with an Environmental Management Plan; full EIA Report is not required for colocation premises without sensitive-habitat impact. A basic registration and an approved management plan apply where backup diesel generators or volatile-cooling systems are installed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial process wastewater discharge; cooling-tower blowdown must comply with Vanuatu ambient water quality standards for industrial discharge. Diesel generator exhaust must meet national air quality limits including PM10 below 50 µg/m³ and NOx below 300 mg/Nm³. Waste batteries, oils and e-waste must be stored in sealed containment and exported only under Basel Convention transboundary-movement controls.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Services under the Fire Services Act for the server halls and generator rooms; structural load-certification from the Ministry of Public Works confirming raised-floor rack loadings; electrical installation clearance from the Electrician Licensing Board verifying UPS and stand-by generator circuits; and workplace occupational clearance under the Work Health and Safety Act, including rack-mount lift plans, fire-exit signage and confined-space procedures for cooling and cable risers.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Department (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; the Commissioner of Inland Revenue administers the Value Added Tax Act No. 30 of 1998 (Cap 313) through the VAT Office in Port Vila / Luganville, with electronic filing via the Vanuatu Integrated Tax Administration System (VITAS) portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The International Company (IC) is exempt from income tax and stamp duty, so no income-tax TIN is issued. Where the IC carries on or intends to carry on a taxable activity in Vanuatu with actual or anticipated annual taxable turnover above VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 41,000), it must submit a VAT Registration Application via VITAS (or prescribed paper form) within 21 days of crossing the threshold or within 21 days of commencing activity. The application is supported by the VFSC certificate of incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, registered office address, data-centre lease or ownership evidence, director identity documents, and a statutory declaration of expected turnover. VCIR then issues a Certificate of Registration bearing a unique VAT registration number, which serves as the IC's statutory tax identity for indirect-tax purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No corporate income tax or check-the-box / hybrid mismatch election exists because Vanuatu does not levy CIT. Available elections under the VAT Act are: (i) voluntary VAT registration below the VUV 5,000,000 threshold; (ii) application for Commissioner approval to zero-rate qualifying exported services; and (iii) maintaining non-resident status without any Vanuatu physical data-centre presence so that no taxable activity arises. No other statutory tax-classification elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 30 of 1998 (Cap 313), a credit-method, destination-based VAT administered by VCIR
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 (approximately USD 41,000) of annual taxable turnover; registration is mandatory within 21 days of crossing this threshold, and there is no territorial carve-out for ICs conducting in-Vanuatu data-centre colocation activities.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic-invoicing clearance, fiscal data stamping, or API integration mandate is currently enforced by VCIR. Standard-rated and zero-rated supplies are documented by self-issued VAT invoices with sequential numbering and mandatory content (supplier name and VAT ID, recipient details, invoice date, description, taxable value, VAT amount, and total). VAT returns and supporting schedules are filed electronically through the VITAS portal; invoices and underlying records must be retained for at least 7 years.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods qualify for 0% VAT when physically removed from Vanuatu, and exported services qualify where supplied to non-resident recipients and the Commissioner is satisfied that the services are performed outside Vanuatu or their value is in no way attributable to property situated in Vanuatu. Server rack space physically located in a Vanuatu data centre is presumed connected with local property and therefore standard-rated unless the IC obtains a binding VCIR ruling that the supply is an offshore bare-metal hosting / managed data-processing service performed for non-resident clients, with billing in foreign currency and no local attribution of value.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Vanuatu Customs SAD/ED Form) cleared through VITAS proving the physical export of eligible goods
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing the movement of exported goods outside Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or bank foreign-exchange receipt from a Vanuatu licensed bank evidencing receipt of the export proceeds
Executed international service agreement with the non-resident recipient and the zero-rated VAT invoice pack
Commissioner-approved zero-rating ruling or endorsement letter for offshore data-centre services where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VCIR audits zero-rating claims by reconciling the export bundle, shipment logs, service contracts, and FX remittance evidence. Unsupported or fraudulent claims are clawed back as assessments of the underpaid 12.5% VAT, with an immediate late penalty of 5%, continued default interest of 1% per month (or SDR-linked statutory interest), an evasion penalty of up to 150% of the VAT liability, and criminal liability including fines and up to two years' imprisonment under the VAT Act. Repeated violations trigger cancellation of VAT registration, exclusion from the zero-rating regime, and suspension of refunds pending full documentary verification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act 1980 (Cap. 125); statutory holder of the exchange-control mandate under the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 85), supervising authorised dealer banks, the VUV interbank market and the national RTGS payment system (Vanuatu National Payment System). Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) registers and supervises International Companies but exercises no FX licensing power.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is convertible for all current-account transactions with minimal administrative encumbrance, and the capital account is liberalised for non-resident investors; the International Company (IC) structure carries an express statutory exemption from domestic exchange-control restrictions, authorising the entity to conduct business and hold accounts in any convertible currency (USD, AUD, EUR, GBP, NZD). No RBV approval or exchange-control permit is required to invoice data-center colocation fees in USD, to hold USD treasury balances, or to remit lease income, affiliate fees, dividends and loan repayments abroad. The operative constraints are commercial rather than legal: VUV is a thin, basket-referenced currency quoted against AUD, USD, NZD, EUR and JPY, and global correspondent banks apply enhanced de-risking filters to Vanuatu-domiciled tax-exempt entities, so the treasury blueprint must keep USD as the dominant operating, invoicing and debt-service currency while channelling VUV only for local payroll, utilities and statutory obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no export-proceeds surrender or conversion regime: neither the Exchange Control Act, RBV delegated directions, nor dealer practice prescribes a statutory timeline for converting export or lease receipts into VUV nor any mandatory minimum conversion ratio. Lease and colocation service receipts may therefore be retained 100% in the original billing currency (USD) in a designated foreign-currency account. Authorised dealers complete routine balance-of-payments reporting to the RBV and file currency-transaction reports under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act (as amended) when statutory monetary thresholds are triggered; the reporting duty is statistical and suspicious-transaction-oriented, requiring no treasury approval action.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD/VUV Account and RTGS/NPS clearing access

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee (registration renewal payment under the International Companies Act, Cap 222)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; the payment renews the company's registration for the following 12-month period.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late payment penalty of 10% of the annual fee is applied immediately after the anniversary; continued default beyond the applicable grace period exposes the company to administrative strike-off by VFSC and loss of separate legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Confirmation (Section 18 of the International Companies Act)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC through the licensed Vanuatu registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, coordinated with the incorporation anniversary; any change of registered agent or registered office must additionally be notified within 21 days.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent and a registered office in Vanuatu constitutes a statutory default enabling VFSC to strike off the company; the company is barred from executing new contracts while in default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Beneficial Ownership and Client Due Diligence Refresh (record maintained by the registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC AML Compliance Unit through the registered agent; no public filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation; within 30 days after any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Persistent CDD deficiencies may lead to VFSC administrative measures or a referral to the Financial Intelligence Unit; non-cooperation by the company can support VFSC strike-off consideration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Public Annual Return and Statutory Audit Filing (explicit statutory exemption confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Exempt; no filing with the VFSC Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable; International Companies file no public annual return or audited accounts, and all registered-agent-held records remain confidential.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: None imposed by VFSC; however, if audited statements are mandated by the company's Articles, a lender, or a colocation lease covenant, failure to produce them constitutes a private contractual breach rather than a registration offence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit threshold exists for a Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act (Cap 222); an audit is never automatically triggered by turnover, total assets, or shareholder count. An independent certified audit becomes obligatory only where required by the company's own Articles of Association, a financier, an equity investor, or a data-center colocation financing or lease covenant.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vanuatu law does not prescribe a statutory accounting framework for tax-exempt International Companies; books may be maintained under IFRS or the local GAAP of the ultimate parent group, with the registered agent retaining sufficient accounting evidence to support CDD records and confirm the absence of economic-substance concerns.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual beneficial-ownership confirmation is made privately to the registered agent, not as a public filing. On each incorporation anniversary, the agent refreshes the client due-diligence file, reconciles the Register of Members against any share transfers executed during the year, and verifies all natural persons holding 25% or more of the shares or otherwise exercising control. The confirmation date is recorded in the statutory records, share-transfer instruments are retained, and any mid-year change must be reported to the agent within 30 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – 900 per annum (VFSC-licensed registered agent plus registered office service)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – 4,000 per annum (optional; engaged only where the Articles, a lender, or a colocation financing covenant requires certified accounts)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies Act (Cap 222) grants full exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, and all withholding taxes; no payroll tax or social security contributions for international employees; only annual VFSC renewal fees apply.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: N/A – No corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The only statutory periodic filing is the VFSC Annual Renewal Statement submitted via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VFSC renewal fee and statement due on or before 30 June annually; no income tax deadline applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No corporate income tax declaration is required for International Companies; dividends, interest, and royalties paid to non-residents are not reportable to any tax authority.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders and directors have no tax filing obligations; VFSC annual return requires registered agent confirmation of beneficial ownership and registered office.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VFSC renewal incurs a default penalty and, if prolonged, strike-off from the register without further notice. No tax late filing surcharge applies.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreements (DTAs) for income tax. No treaty clearance procedure, tax residence certificate, or DTA relief application is required for outbound profit distributions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding tax on interest and royalties; no reduced treaty rates available absent any DTA network.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: N/A — Vanuatu has no transfer pricing legislation; no local file/master file monetization thresholds are prescribed.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations (Cap 247) apply to tax-resident companies engaged in specified relevant activities. Data center colocation is relevant only if structured as a 'distribution and service centre' providing services to foreign group members. Third-party colocation leasing is generally outside ESR unless the company is a tax resident and the activity is deemed a service business. In-scope entities must maintain local management, physical premises, and adequate employees in Vanuatu.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion Abroad / Misleading Foreign Tax Authority
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu International Company to create the appearance of tax non-residence in the beneficial owner's home country, thereby concealing a permanent establishment, or submitting false foreign tax filings claiming Vanuatu tax residence or exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu itself imposes no income tax, so domestic tax evasion penalties do not arise; however, such conduct constitutes fraud under Vanuatu Penal Code, exposing the company to VFSC deregistration, and may activate foreign revenue penalties and exchange-of-information requests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal civil authorization for foreign tax assessments, asset forfeiture, travel bans under mutual assistance channels, and imprisonment in the prosecuting foreign jurisdiction for criminal tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the data center colocation business with no physical presence in Vanuatu, no local employees, no board meetings conducted in country, and no substantive operational decision-making — nominal activity designed solely to obtain VFSC registration benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: If the company is within the Economic Substance Regulations, failure to satisfy the substance test results in financial penalties, a possible direction to provide information, and ultimately strike-off. Outside ESR, persistent non-compliance with registered agent and annual renewal obligations leads to automatic removal from the VFSC register.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally disqualified from acting in Vanuatu, held jointly liable for VFSC fees and penalties, and subject to imprisonment for knowingly providing false declarations to the VFSC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to implement AML/CFT systems when leasing data center capacity to customers that are unregulated financial service providers, brokers, or cryptocurrency platforms; processing layered third-party payments without client due diligence or suspicious transaction reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Vanuatu's AML/CFT Act, financial institutions and DNFBPs face criminal fines, forfeiture of assets, and revocation of any registration or license; the VFSC may also suspend corporate registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally liable for criminal penalties, including imprisonment and civil monetary penalties, and may be subject to travel bans restricting ability to leave Vanuatu pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Bundling server leasing with payment processing, virtual asset custody, or investment advisory services without obtaining the required VFSC Financial Dealership licence under the Dealers in Securities Act or the Investment Promotion Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Conducting financial services without a licence triggers cease-and-desist orders, administrative penalties, and a court-ordered winding-up if the business is deemed harmful to Vanuatu's regulatory regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face criminal liability including substantial fines and imprisonment, as well as permanent disqualification from managing any company in Vanuatu; personal bank accounts may be subject to freezing orders.
